title: Evaluation coherence of generic stratum-Hom exchange
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $s:S\hookrightarrow X$ be an immersion, with fixed closed-then-open factorization, and let $s':S'\hookrightarrow X'$ be its cartesian pullback along a scheme morphism $g_X:X'\to X$, with $g_S:S'\to S$ [def-pc-base-change, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Use $Rs_!,Rs^!,Rs_*$ and their primed versions from these factorizations, with $Rs_!=j_!i_*$ and $Rs^!=Ri^!j^*$ [lem-cbc-open-closed-recollement, lem-exc-closed-ambient]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], derived tensor $\otimes_A^L$ [def-kun-derived-tensor], and derived internal Hom $\mathscr H_T(U,V)=R\mathcal Hom_{A_T}(U,V)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Scheme inverse images on these categories are exact constant-coefficient inverse images [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Let $P\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and $H=\mathscr H_S(P,Rs^!M)$. Write $b:g_X^*Rs_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rs'_!g_S^*$ for canonical extension-by-zero base change, $e:g_X^*Rs_*\to Rs'_*g_S^*$ for the adjunction-mate exchange, and $a:g_S^*Rs^!M\to Rs'^!g_X^*M$ for a comparison satisfying the exceptional counit identity
$$\varepsilon^!_{s',g_X^*M}\circ Rs'_!(a)\circ b_{Rs^!M}=g_X^*\varepsilon^!_{s,M}.$$
Assume the canonical projection isomorphisms commute with $g^*$ under $b$ [lem-sf-etale-generic-immersion-projection]. Use the evaluation-normalized isomorphisms $\theta_s,\theta_{s'}$ of [lem-sf-etale-generic-stratum-mate], and let $\beta_{P,Rs^!M}$ be the transpose of pulled-back evaluation. Then the composite
$$g_X^*\mathscr H_X(Rs_!P,M)\xrightarrow{g_X^*\theta_s}g_X^*Rs_*H\xrightarrow{e_H}Rs'_*g_S^*H\xrightarrow{Rs'_*\beta_{P,Rs^!M}}Rs'_*\mathscr H_{S'}(g_S^*P,g_S^*Rs^!M)\xrightarrow{Rs'_*\mathscr H(1,a)}Rs'_*\mathscr H_{S'}(g_S^*P,Rs'^!g_X^*M)\xrightarrow{\theta_{s'}^{-1}}\mathscr H_{X'}(Rs'_!g_S^*P,g_X^*M)$$
has tensor transpose $g_X^*\mathrm{ev}_{Rs_!P,M}$ after identifying its tensor input by $b_P$ and the canonical tensor pullback map. Thus it equals the canonical evaluation-induced comparison $\beta_{Rs_!P,M}$. This assertion is an identity of maps and assumes no isomorphism property of $e_H$, $a$, or $\beta_{P,Rs^!M}$.
